mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alphafrog_agent_run_event (run_id, seq, event_type, payload_json) VALUES (#{runId}, #{seq}, #{eventType}, CAST(#{payloadJson} AS jsonb))

INSERT INTO alphafrog_agent_run_event (run_id, seq, event_type, payload_json, dedupe_key) VALUES (#{runId}, #{seq}, #{eventType}, CAST(#{payloadJson} AS jsonb), #{dedupeKey}) ON CONFLICT (run_id, dedupe_key) WHERE dedupe_key IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id, seq, event_type, payload_json::text AS payload_json, dedupe_key, created_at FROM alphafrog_agent_run_event WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND dedupe_key = #{dedupeKey} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, run_id, seq, event_type, payload_json::text AS payload_json, created_at FROM alphafrog_agent_run_event WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND seq > #{afterSeq} ORDER BY seq ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, run_id, seq, event_type, payload_json::text AS payload_json, created_at FROM alphafrog_agent_run_event WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, run_id, seq, event_type, payload_json::text AS payload_json, created_at FROM ( SELECT id, run_id, seq, event_type, payload_json, created_at FROM alphafrog_agent_run_event WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) latest_events ORDER BY seq ASC
SELECT id, run_id, seq, event_type, payload_json::text AS payload_json, created_at FROM alphafrog_agent_run_event WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY seq ASC
